description: NVIDIA Parakeet-TDT 0.6B v3 FastConformer-TDT ASR covering 25 European languages with automatic language detection, loaded from the repository's Transformers-compatible safetensors checkpoint. Offline full-context transcription only; the checkpoint is trained with unlimited bidirectional attention and is not a cache-aware streaming model.

request.name: max_tokens
request.description: Maximum TDT generated tokens; 0 or omitted uses the model-derived limit.

request.name: keep_language_tags
request.description: Keep language tag tokens in decoded text.

session.name: weight_type
session.description: Shared matmul weight storage type; default native.

session.name: matmul_weight_type
session.description: Encoder and decoder matmul weight storage type; defaults to weight_type, which defaults to native. q8_0 measures 1.79x faster on CPU and changes roughly 8 percent of transcripts without moving aggregate word error rate.

session.name: conv_weight_type
session.description: Convolution weight storage type; default native.

session.name: encoder_flash_attention
session.description: Run the encoder's relative-position self-attention through the fused flash-attention op; default false. Numerically validated but measured slower than the default path on the hardware tested.

session.name: weight_context_mb
session.description: Weight context arena size in MiB; default 3072.

session.name: encoder_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Encoder graph arena size in MiB; default 1024.

session.name: decoder_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Decoder graph arena size in MiB; default 256.
